ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) Multiple Accounts with Address Changed to Same Address

Connections or linkages between accounts based on the registration information associated with accounts can support the detection of fraudulent activity. In particular, contact and statement notification information, such as mailing address, which is common across seemingly unrelated accounts could indicate fraudulent activity such as account takeover schemes affecting multiple accounts, especially for cases in which multiple accounts are changed to the same post office box (POB) or care of (C/O) address. This scenario identifies cases where multiple customer accounts have had their mailing addresses changed to the same new address during the lookback period.
